stories.title: UK budget leaves NI underfunded, O'Dowd says
stories.summary: Northern Ireland's public funding has worsened relative to rest of the UK as a result of the Westminster budget, Stormont's Finance Minister has claimed.

stories.title: Tributes as wife and daughter of DUP chairman die hours apart
stories.summary: Lord Morrow has served as Chairman of the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) since 2000.

stories.title: Plans confirmed to reopen Glens of Antrim Potato crisp factory
stories.summary: A Northern Ireland crisp brand are set to return to supermarket shelves after a family-run food producer announced plans to restart production.

stories.title: 'Striking absence of public accountability' over BBC NI cuts
stories.summary: Some shows in Northern Ireland have been axed and services scaled back as part of the BBC targeting £500m of savings in two years.

stories.title: Sinn Féin 'content' with 1998 bombing campaign, Omagh inquiry told
stories.summary: Retired Chief Superintendent Norman Baxter was giving evidence at an inquiry into the 1998 bombing.

stories.title: 'Racist comments not acceptable' - cafe owner speaks out over long-running abuse
stories.summary: Saba Asghar-Rahman, the owner of a restaurant in Ballymoney, County Antrim, says racism was "not acceptable".

stories.title: Man jailed for two years after 'systematic and persistent' rioting
stories.summary: Ashton Thompson threw missiles at police and was part of a mob which pursued officers during disorder in Ballymena in 2025.

stories.title: Young adults with learning disabilities make Last Leg TV wrestling debut
stories.summary: Members of the Tuned In Project showcased their wrestling skills on Channel 4's The Last Leg.

stories.title: Reported bird flu case being investigated
stories.summary: Samples have been sent to the national reference laboratory in England for analysis, with results expected tomorrow.

stories.title: Child left with face and body injuries after 'deplorable' sectarian attack
stories.summary: Three masked males came out of a parked car and attacked the boy on a main road in Derry, police say.

stories.title: Man sentenced over 'horrific' attempted murder of three children
stories.summary: Riad Bouchaker was sentenced after the attempted murder of three children in November 2023.

stories.title: 'We know we can do it' - Farrell eyes Springbok scalp
stories.summary: Head coach Andy Farrell says Ireland will look to draw inspiration from the big wins they have had under his watch when they renew their rivalry with world champions South Africa this weekend.
